# technitium_settings_protocols (Resource)

Manages optional DNS transports: DNS-over-TLS/HTTPS/QUIC and PROXY-protocol listeners.

This is a singleton: declare it once. Attributes left unset follow the server's current value. Destroying the resource only removes it from state; server settings are not reset.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dns_over_http_port` (Number) DNS-over-HTTP port.
- `dns_over_http_unix_socket` (String) DoH HTTP Unix socket path.
- `dns_over_https_port` (Number) DNS-over-HTTPS port.
- `dns_over_https_unix_socket` (String) DoH HTTPS Unix socket path.
- `dns_over_quic_port` (Number) DNS-over-QUIC port.
- `dns_over_tcp_proxy_port` (Number) DNS-over-TCP-PROXY port.
- `dns_over_tls_port` (Number) DNS-over-TLS port.
- `dns_over_udp_proxy_port` (Number) DNS-over-UDP-PROXY port.
- `enable_dns_over_http` (Boolean) Accept plain-HTTP DoH behind a TLS-terminating proxy.
- `enable_dns_over_http3` (Boolean) Enable DNS-over-HTTP/3.
- `enable_dns_over_http_help_redirect` (Boolean) Redirect browsers hitting the DoH endpoint to a help page.
- `enable_dns_over_http_unix_socket` (Boolean) Listen for DoH on an HTTP Unix socket.
- `enable_dns_over_https` (Boolean) Enable DNS-over-HTTPS.
- `enable_dns_over_https_unix_socket` (Boolean) Listen for DoH on an HTTPS Unix socket.
- `enable_dns_over_quic` (Boolean) Enable DNS-over-QUIC.
- `enable_dns_over_tcp_proxy` (Boolean) Accept DNS-over-TCP with the PROXY protocol.
- `enable_dns_over_tls` (Boolean) Enable DNS-over-TLS.
- `enable_dns_over_udp_proxy` (Boolean) Accept DNS-over-UDP with the PROXY protocol.
- `real_ip_header` (String) Header carrying the client IP for DNS-over-HTTP.
- `reverse_proxy_network_acl` (List of String) Proxies allowed to use the PROXY-protocol and DoH-over-HTTP listeners.
- `tls_certificate_password` (String, Sensitive) Certificate password. Not readable from the server.
- `tls_certificate_path` (String) Path to a PKCS #12 (.pfx) certificate for DoT/DoH/DoQ.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `settings`.
